about_page.title: About Us
about_page.body_html:
Zhang Hongming Zisha Studio

Zhang Hongming is a Senior Arts & Crafts Artist in Yixing, the birthplace of zisha (purple clay) teapots. Together with Yang Junying, Yu Jiahua, and Zhang Zhaoyang, our studio crafts teapots by hand — from clay selection and shaping to firing in traditional kilns.

Why buy from us

  • Authentic Yixing zisha — real purple clay, not chemical blends
  • Shipped from Yixing — direct from our workshop in Jiangsu, China
  • Worldwide delivery — Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, US, and Europe
  • Each piece is unique — inventory of one per listing

关于我们

张洪明，正高级工艺美术师，宜兴紫砂全手工制作。家族匠人杨俊英、郁佳骅、张赵阳共同参与选泥、制作、烧制与质检。

每一把壶从江苏宜兴直发，支持 PayPal 付款，香港及全球配送。
